description:
Could a modern hippo survive every prehistoric era? Doug takes one back through time, from Ice Age London 125,000 years ago past giant crocodiles, Titanoboa, T. rex and the Permian gorgonopsians, all the way to the Hadean Earth 4.4 billion years ago.

Where should we send Doug (and the hippo) next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you're here for Doug's next bad idea.
